The moment you understand that comfort is a tax on your future, you will stop seeking it.

Everything you want is behind the wall of what you are currently avoiding.

Fun fact: Ignorance debt compounds faster than interest.

The longer you wait to learn the hard skills, the more expensive your eventual reality becomes.

If you're not failing, consider checking if you're actually playing the game.

Growth exists exclusively in the gap between what you think you know and the reality of the market.
